name: Lifeguard Training
org: City of Saint Paul Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: A Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding with deep water, CPR/AED and first aid, valid 2 years). Graduates can be hired as City of Saint Paul lifeguards.
who_can_apply: Age 15 or older. You must pass a swim test in the first class (150 yard swim, tread water, a 20 yard timed swim and a 12 foot dive to get a 10 pound object) and show a birth certificate with photo ID.
pay_detail: Course cost and lifeguard pay are not listed on the page.
deadline_text: No course dates are posted. Main summer hiring for certified guards runs mid April to June.
how_to_apply: Sign up online through the city system. Or call Como Park Pool at 651-489-0378, Highland Aquatic Center at 651-695-3773, or Great River Water Park at 651-642-0390. After you pass, call Great River Water Park to apply for a job.
notes: You need 80 percent on the written exam and must pass all skills. Work permit rule for Minnesota minors not checked.
